text:
emma_marketing: Hey team — draft for the product post is up for a quick pass: https://docs.google.com/document/d/REDACTED. Can we get checks on the hero blurb, benchmarks paragraph, and the webinar CTA/UTMs by EOD? Planning to schedule publish + webinar invite once we have final copy. :sparkles:

jason_pm: Quick read — looks solid. One ask: can we avoid asserting `sub-50ms` without p95 numbers? Suggest `sub-80ms median` or include both p50 and p95 with citations.

lena_engineering: @jason_pm we can do p50 ~42ms, p95 ~120ms for small-batch workloads. Happy to add both. Also recommend we use the term `Dedicated routing` (product name) instead of `smart routing` in the hero so it's consistent with the docs.

tariq_ops: For the webinar CTA, routing should go to /webinar/redwood-optimize with UTM params. Quick UTM snippet you can paste: `/webinar/redwood-optimize?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=product_launch_2026`

sofia_legal: Flag — the phrase "industry-leading" is risky unless we have benchmark comparisons. Prefer "industry-grade" or drop the qualifier. Also need clearance for using the phrase "Redwood-verified" in marketing assets — pinging legal team.

emma_marketing: Good catches. I'll swap to "industry-grade" and only use "Redwood-verified" where we have clearance. @sofia_legal can you confirm trademark/status by noon?

product-analytics-bot: PR tracking sheet updated: https://sheets.re/redwood/marketing (row 12 updated by emma_marketing)

jason_pm: For the benchmarks section can we include a small chart or at least bulleted metrics (p50, p95, avg token cost)? I can pull the cost numbers if helpful.

lena_engineering: I'll export a tiny chart (png) and add the raw numbers. Also adding cache hit-rate stat: average prompt prefix cache hit ~37% over last 30 days — worth a one-line callout.

emma_marketing: Dropping the current draft snippet below — please keep edits minimal so I can lock down copy. Publish target Wed 03/25 09:00 PT if we have no blockers.

[Draft snippet]
"Redwood Optimize reduces per-token inference cost while preserving latency SLOs with intelligent batching, cache-aware routing, and quantization recommendations."

end snippet

tariq_ops: :thumbsup: From ops side this reads fine. Also confirm inbound flow: webinar registrants should map to HubSpot lead source "product_launch" so Sales sees them correctly.

sofia_legal: Confirmed: "Redwood-verified" is cleared for marketing use in this context. :white_check_mark:

emma_marketing: Amazing — thanks everyone. Final pass by 6pm and I'll schedule the publish + webinar invite. :rocket:
